title: Sign in to AdviseCare
subtitle: Use your personal Google account, or the email/username and password of your AdviseCare account.
invalidCredentials: The email/username or password is incorrect.
accountUnavailable: This account is inactive or access is unavailable. Contact your system administrator.
conflictError: This request conflicts with the current account state.
requestError: The request could not be completed.
networkError: The AdviseCare API is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
notFound: The requested sign-in resource could not be found.
expiredSession: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
logoutUnconfirmed: Your local session was cleared, but the API could not confirm remote sign-out.
accessDenied: Your account does not have permission to open this workspace.
forgotSubtitle: Enter your account email. If it is linked and active, the API will send a one-time reset link.
resetSubmitted: If the account is eligible, a password reset email has been sent.
resetFailed: The password reset request could not be completed.
legalLine: AdviseCare records access and consent decisions according to the institutional data-protection workflow.
coverStatement: Ask for help, get the right advisor, and keep track until it is resolved.
coverLine1: Students send a request and choose what data to share.
coverLine2: The Programme Head matches it to the right advisor.
coverLine3: Every note and every data read is recorded and visible.
firstTimeHint: First time here? Open the account-linking email the university sent you and link your Google account first.
resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
resetSubtitle: After saving, every device signed in to your account is signed out.
passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
linkSubtitle: Your AdviseCare account was created by the university. Link it to your personal Google account to sign in.
linkStep1: Choose the Google account whose email matches the one this link was sent to.
linkStep2: After linking you are signed in and can set a password in Settings.
linkMissingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email, or ask the administrator to resend it.
linkRefused: This Google account could not be linked. Use the Google account with the same email, or ask for a new link.
googleNotLinked: This Google account is not linked to any AdviseCare account yet.
googleUnavailable: Google sign-in could not load. Use your password instead.
googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured on this server (NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).
emailInvalid: Enter the email address of your account, e.g. name@example.edu.vn.
subtitlePassword: Sign in with the email or username and password of your AdviseCare account.
